shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在绿色安全出口标志下，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands under a green emergency exit sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲火警报告与疏散逃生。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 警铃响起，阿杰还在记录数据
shots.prompt_en: An alarm sounder flashes on the wall while the young male student keeps writing down data at his bench.
shots.narration: 警铃响了，阿杰想：先把数据记完。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拉起阿杰往外走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student taps his shoulder and leads him toward the exit.
shots.narration: 小研说：警报响了，马上走！

shots.section_title: 发现火情，先喊人、按警报
shots.scene: 小研发现冒烟，大声呼喊
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notices smoke and shouts loudly to warn others.
shots.narration: 发现火情，先大声喊人。
overlay: 发现火情，先喊人、按警报

shots.section_title: 发现火情，先喊人、按警报
shots.scene: 按下走廊里的手动火灾报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses the manual fire alarm call point on the corridor wall. No faces.
shots.narration: 就近按下手动火灾报警按钮。

shots.section_title: 发现火情，先喊人、按警报
shots.scene: 一个人悄悄跑掉，不提醒别人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A figure sneaks away silently without warning anyone, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 不能一声不吭跑掉。

shots.section_title: 发现火情，先喊人、按警报
shots.scene: 先护住自己，再提醒别人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers her mouth and steps toward the exit while waving others along.
shots.narration: 先保证自己安全，顺手报警提醒别人。

shots.section_title: 拨打119说清楚，同时报告学校
shots.scene: 手机拨号界面显示119
shots.prompt_en: A phone dial screen shows 119 being called. No text.
shots.narration: 火警电话119。
overlay: 拨打119说清楚，同时报告学校

shots.section_title: 拨打119说清楚，同时报告学校
shots.scene: 地点、燃烧物、被困人员三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a map pin, a burning bottle, a trapped figure. No text.
shots.narration: 说清地点、烧的什么、有没有人被困。

shots.section_title: 拨打119说清楚，同时报告学校
shots.scene: 接警员还在问，阿杰没挂电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student keeps the phone to his ear, answering questions calmly.
shots.narration: 等对方问完再挂电话。

shots.section_title: 拨打119说清楚，同时报告学校
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接校内报警电话
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers the campus emergency line at the security desk.
shots.narration: 同时打校内报警电话，报告保卫处。

shots.section_title: 拨打119说清楚，同时报告学校
shots.scene: 王老师接到电话，向学院报告
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator receives the call and reports to the school office.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人和学院。

shots.section_title: 拨打119说清楚，同时报告学校
shots.scene: 手机拨号界面显示120
shots.prompt_en: A phone dial screen shows 120 being called. No text.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，拨打120。

shots.section_title: 火大或拿不准，放弃扑救就撤
shots.scene: 火势变大，阿杰放下灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows bigger; the young male student puts down the extinguisher.
shots.narration: 火大了，或者没把握，别冒险。
overlay: 火大或拿不准，放弃扑救就撤

shots.section_title: 火大或拿不准，放弃扑救就撤
shots.scene: 通风柜内火失控，拉下视窗后撤离
shots.prompt_en: A fire in a fume hood grows; a hand pulls the sash down and the person leaves. No faces.
shots.narration: 通风柜火失控，拉下视窗就撤。

shots.section_title: 火大或拿不准，放弃扑救就撤
shots.scene: 按报警、拨119、撤离三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an alarm button, a phone, a running exit figure. No text.
shots.narration: 按报警、打119，沿疏散路线撤离。

shots.section_title: 撤离前，安全的话关电关气拉视窗
shots.scene: 关闭电源开关和燃气阀
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the bench power and closes the gas valve. No faces.
shots.narration: 安全的话，先关电器和燃气。
overlay: 撤离前，安全的话关电关气拉视窗

shots.section_title: 撤离前，安全的话关电关气拉视窗
shots.scene: 拉下通风柜视窗，然后离开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls down the fume hood sash and walks away.
shots.narration: 在通风柜操作的，拉下视窗再走。

shots.section_title: 撤离前，安全的话关电关气拉视窗
shots.scene: 火已逼近，什么都不管直接走
shots.prompt_en: Flames are close; the figure leaves right away without touching anything. No faces.
shots.narration: 来不及就别管，人先走。

shots.section_title: 警报一响立即撤离，别管实验
shots.scene: 警报响，学生立刻起身离开
shots.prompt_en: The alarm sounds and students stand up and leave immediately.
shots.narration: 听到警报，立即疏散。
overlay: 警报一响立即撤离，别管实验

shots.section_title: 警报一响立即撤离，别管实验
shots.scene: 关电脑、等广播、收拾东西三个图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three crossed-out icons: shutting down a computer, waiting for an announcement, packing a bag. No text.
shots.narration: 不等广播，不收拾东西，不磨蹭。

shots.section_title: 警报一响立即撤离，别管实验
shots.scene: 阿杰以为误报，打叉；关热源撤离，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Left: the young male student ignoring the alarm, crossed out; right: switching off heat and leaving, checked.
shots.narration: 别当误报，是否误报由值班员确认。

shots.section_title: 警报一响立即撤离，别管实验
shots.scene: 实验记录和人在天平两端，人更重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a person icon outweighing a lab notebook and samples. No text.
shots.narration: 紧急时最不重要的，是完成实验。

shots.section_title: 低姿捂鼻、走楼梯、随手关门
shots.scene: 走廊上方浓烟，人弯腰低姿前进
shots.prompt_en: Thick smoke near the corridor ceiling; people move forward bent low. No faces.
shots.narration: 烟大时，低姿前进。
overlay: 低姿捂鼻、走楼梯、随手关门

shots.section_title: 低姿捂鼻、走楼梯、随手关门
shots.scene: 用湿毛巾捂住口鼻
shots.prompt_en: A person covers the nose and mouth with a wet towel while moving to the exit. No faces.
shots.narration: 用湿毛巾或衣物捂住口鼻。

shots.section_title: 低姿捂鼻、走楼梯、随手关门
shots.scene: 走楼梯，电梯打叉
shots.prompt_en: People walk down the stairwell; the elevator door beside it is crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 走楼梯，不乘电梯。

shots.section_title: 低姿捂鼻、走楼梯、随手关门
shots.scene: 最后离开的人随手关门，门挡住烟
shots.prompt_en: The last person out closes the door behind and the smoke is held back. No faces.
shots.narration: 离开时随手关门，挡住烟火。

shots.section_title: 低姿捂鼻、走楼梯、随手关门
shots.scene: 门把手烫，换另一条路
shots.prompt_en: A hand feels a hot door handle and pulls back, then the figure turns to another route. No faces.
shots.narration: 门把发烫，别开门，换条路走。

shots.section_title: 熟悉多条疏散路线，亲自走一遍
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校楼层出口附近墙上的疏散路线图（近景，平移）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an evacuation route map mounted on a corridor wall near an exit.
shots.narration: 出口附近贴着疏散路线图。
overlay: 熟悉多条疏散路线，亲自走一遍

shots.section_title: 熟悉多条疏散路线，亲自走一遍
shots.scene: 平面图上两条路线，一条被堵，走另一条
shots.prompt_en: A blank floor plan with two exit routes; one is blocked with an X, the other glows green. No text.
shots.narration: 多记几条路线，一条堵了走另一条。

shots.section_title: 熟悉多条疏散路线，亲自走一遍
shots.scene: 王老师带新生沿疏散路线完整走一遍
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks new students along the full evacuation route to the outside.
shots.narration: 疏散路线要亲自完整走一遍。

shots.section_title: 熟悉多条疏散路线，亲自走一遍
shots.scene: 沿途经过楼梯口、防火门、出口的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons along a route: stairs, a fire door, an exit door. No text.
shots.narration: 弄清楚途中要经过哪些地方。

shots.section_title: 熟悉多条疏散路线，亲自走一遍
shots.scene: 小研阅读应急预案和学校规定
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank emergency plan booklet at her desk.
shots.narration: 本楼的应急预案和学校规定，读一读。

shots.section_title: 到集合点清点人数，不许返回
shots.scene: 楼外空地上的集合点，人群聚集
shots.prompt_en: People gather at an assembly point on open ground outside the building. No text.
shots.narration: 撤出后到紧急集合点集合。
overlay: 到集合点清点人数，不许返回

shots.section_title: 到集合点清点人数，不许返回
shots.scene: 王老师清点人数
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator counts students one by one at the assembly point.
shots.narration: 清点人数，有人没到马上报告。

shots.section_title: 到集合点清点人数，不许返回
shots.scene: 有人想回楼取东西，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A student turns back toward the building for a bag, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 出来了就别回头取东西。

shots.section_title: 到集合点清点人数，不许返回
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员示意可以返回
shots.prompt_en: The security officer gives an all-clear signal to the group at the assembly point.
shots.narration: 没有通知，任何人不许返回。

shots.section_title: 互相照应：行动不便者和访客有人带
shots.scene: 能行走的人先撤，专人扶着行动不便的同学
shots.prompt_en: People who can walk leave first; a helper supports a student on crutches toward the exit. No faces.
shots.narration: 先撤能走的，行动不便者专人协助。
overlay: 互相照应：行动不便者和访客有人带

shots.section_title: 互相照应：行动不便者和访客有人带
shots.scene: 访客跟着老周撤离
shots.prompt_en: Visitors follow the older man along the evacuation route to the assembly point.
shots.narration: 访客跟着向导走，到集合点清点。

shots.section_title: 认清安全出口标志和应急照明
shots.scene: 【实拍】本校安全出口标志和地面疏散指示标志（近景）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a green emergency exit sign above a door and a floor-level evacuation direction sign.
shots.narration: 绿色安全出口标志，指向安全出口。
overlay: 认清安全出口标志和应急照明

shots.section_title: 认清安全出口标志和应急照明
shots.scene: 疏散指示箭头一路指向出口
shots.prompt_en: Green evacuation arrows on walls and floor point the way to the exit. No people.
shots.narration: 跟着疏散指示的箭头走。

shots.section_title: 认清安全出口标志和应急照明
shots.scene: 停电时应急照明亮起
shots.prompt_en: The corridor lights go out and emergency lights switch on. No people.
shots.narration: 停电时，要靠应急照明。

shots.section_title: 认清安全出口标志和应急照明
shots.scene: 标志被遮挡、应急灯不亮，打叉，报修
shots.prompt_en: An exit sign covered by a poster and a dark emergency light, crossed out with a repair tag. No text.
shots.narration: 标志不能遮挡，应急灯不亮就报修。

shots.section_title: 安全出口和疏散通道天天畅通
shots.scene: 安全出口门口堆物、门被锁，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Boxes piled at an exit door and a padlock on it, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 安全出口不堆东西，门不上锁。
overlay: 安全出口和疏散通道天天畅通

shots.section_title: 安全出口和疏散通道天天畅通
shots.scene: 走廊堆杂物，打叉；清理后畅通，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Left: a corridor cluttered with boxes, crossed out; right: a clear corridor, checked. No people.
shots.narration: 走廊、出口不堆杂物。

shots.section_title: 安全出口和疏散通道天天畅通
shots.scene: 防火门被顶开，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fire door propped open with a box, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 防火门保持关闭，不能撑开锁死。

shots.section_title: 安全出口和疏散通道天天畅通
shots.scene: 老李沿疏散路线定期检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks the evacuation route with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 疏散路线定期检查，一路畅通。

shots.section_title: 安全出口和疏散通道天天畅通
shots.scene: 阿杰进实验室先看清两个出口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters a lab and looks at both exit doors.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先认清最近的两个出口。

shots.section_title: 消防环环相扣：四懂四会
shots.scene: 报警、器材、救援、撤离四环相扣
shots.prompt_en: Four linked rings with icons: a phone, an extinguisher, a fire truck, an exit. No text.
shots.narration: 消防一环扣一环。
overlay: 消防环环相扣：四懂四会

shots.section_title: 消防环环相扣：四懂四会
shots.scene: 四懂图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a hazard sign, a shield, an extinguisher, a running figure. No text.
shots.narration: 四懂：懂危险、预防、扑救、逃生。

shots.section_title: 消防环环相扣：四懂四会
shots.scene: 四会图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a phone, an extinguisher, a small fire put out, people evacuating. No text.
shots.narration: 四会：会报警、用器材、灭小火、疏散。

shots.section_title: 参加消防培训和演练
shots.scene: 全楼消防演练，学生有序下楼
shots.prompt_en: During a building fire drill, students walk down the stairs in order.
shots.narration: 参加学校组织的消防演练。

shots.section_title: 参加消防培训和演练
shots.scene: 王老师讲解，学生练习
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains while students practice with a training extinguisher.
shots.narration: 练过才会用，单位要组织培训。

shots.section_title: 人员密集活动：不超容量，防踩踏
shots.scene: 社团活动场地人太多，挤满通道
shots.prompt_en: A student club event hall is overcrowded and people fill the aisles. No faces.
shots.narration: 人数不能超过场地容量。
overlay: 人员密集活动：不超容量，防踩踏

shots.section_title: 人员密集活动：不超容量，防踩踏
shots.scene: 活动前看好出口，安排专人引导
shots.prompt_en: Before an event, organizers check the exits and volunteers stand by the doors. No faces.
shots.narration: 办活动前看好出口，专人引导。

shots.section_title: 人员密集活动：不超容量，防踩踏
shots.scene: 人群有序进出，不推不挤
shots.prompt_en: A crowd leaves the hall in an orderly line without pushing. No faces.
shots.narration: 有序进出，不推不挤，听从指挥。

shots.section_title: 人员密集活动：不超容量，防踩踏
shots.scene: 被挤倒时双手护头、蜷身侧卧
shots.prompt_en: A figure on the ground lies on the side, curled up, both hands protecting the head. No faces.
shots.narration: 万一被挤倒，双手护头，蜷身侧卧。

shots.section_title: 人员密集活动：不超容量，防踩踏
shots.scene: 大型活动事先做好应急预案
shots.prompt_en: Organizers review a blank emergency plan for a large event with the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 大型活动，事先做好应急预案。

shots.section_title: 消防车通道不得占用
shots.scene: 楼外红色消防车通道上停着车，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Cars parked on a fire truck access lane beside a building, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 消防车通道不能停车、堆物。

shots.section_title: 消防车通道不得占用
shots.scene: 通道畅通，消防车顺利开到楼下
shots.prompt_en: The access lane is clear and a fire truck drives right up to the building. No people.
shots.narration: 通道畅通，救援才能及时赶到。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 喊人、按警报、拨119三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons get green checks: shouting, an alarm button, a phone. No text.
shots.narration: 先喊人、按警报、拨打119。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 低姿、楼梯、集合点三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons get green checks: a crouching figure, stairs, an assembly point. No text.
shots.narration: 低姿走楼梯，到集合点，不返回。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在化学品柜前，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a chemical storage cabinet and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲危险化学品法规与全过程管理。
